Thanks — quick operational notes from the VM team: 

- The CSV export will include: asset tag, ip/hostname, vuln id, cvss, severity (P1/P2/P3 mapping), ticket id, first_seen, last_seen, remediation_status. We will redact internal-only tags for external sharing (per NDAs).
- SLA clarification: 
  * P1 (Critical): 14 calendar days to remediation or documented compensating control; if a hotfix is not available we will provide a documented mitigation with ETA updates every 48 hours.
  * P2 (High): 30 calendar days target (we commit to a 45-day max on public infra when third-party vendor patches are required).
  * P3 (Medium/Low): 90 days target.
- Escalation path: VM owner -> Security Engineering -> CTO (for exceptions beyond 45 days).
